exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. Which people are from: Spain, India, Scotland or Brazil?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang. Bu odamlar qaysi mamlakatdan: Ispaniya, Hindiston, Shotlandiya yoki Braziliya?
exercises.explanationUz:
Rasmlardagi kiyim va buyumlar mamlakatni aytib beradi:
• Shotlandiya — kilt (yubkasimon kiyim) va bagpipe (jiroq)
• Hindiston — rangli ro'mol (dupatta)
• Ispaniya — flamenko libosi
• Braziliya — dehqonlar, ketmon bilan
Mamlakat nomlari doim KATTA harf bilan yoziladi.
exercises.bookRef: Coursebook, 6-bet — rasmlar A, B, C, D

exercises.explanationUz:
Bu gaplar butun Unit 1 ning asosi. Ularda 'to be' fe'li ishlatilgan:
• I am / I'm — men ...man
• They are / They're — ular ...
• Where is ...? — qayerda/qayerdan?
Qisqartma shakl (I'm, They're) og'zaki nutqda deyarli doim ishlatiladi.

sentences.en: They're friends and they're from Brazil.
I'm a student at an English boarding-school.

exercises.instructionEn: Can you explain what the sentences above mean?
exercises.explanationUz: Har bir gapning o'zbekcha tarjimasi 2a mashqida berilgan. E'tibor bering: o'zbekchada 'Men qirq yoshdaman' desak, inglizchada 'I am forty years old' — ya'ni 'am' (bo'lmoq fe'li) tushib qolmaydi. Ingliz tilida fe'lsiz gap bo'lmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and match the letters to the numbers you hear.
exercises.instructionUz: Eshiting va harflarni eshitgan raqamlaringizga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz: Har rasm (A, B, C, D) 4 ta matndan biriga to'g'ri keladi. Audio'da matn raqami aytiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts and label the pictures with the correct word in bold. Then, answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnlarni o'qing va rasmlarni qalin yozilgan to'g'ri so'z bilan belgilang. So'ng savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu mashq ikki qismli:
1) Rasm tagidagi bo'shliqqa kasb nomini yozish (matnda qalin harf bilan berilgan).
2) Matn bo'yicha savollarga javob berish.
Diqqat: bitta odam bo'lsa 'I'm a musician', ko'p bo'lsa 'They are farmers' (ko'plik -s).
exercises.readingNote: Matnlarni kitobingizdan o'qing (6-bet). Quyida ularning mazmuni va javoblari berilgan.

questions.en: Where is Fergus from? What's his job?
questions.answerEn: He's from Edinburgh, Scotland. He's a musician.

questions.en: How old is Diego? What's his favourite sport?
questions.uz: Diego necha yoshda? Sevimli sporti nima?
questions.answerEn: He's thirty-five years old. His favourite sport is football.
questions.answerUz: U o'ttiz besh yoshda. Sevimli sporti — futbol.

questions.en: Where are Carlos and Rosa from? How old is Carlos? How old is Rosa?
questions.uz: Carlos va Rosa qayerdan? Carlos necha yoshda? Rosa necha yoshda?
questions.answerEn: They're from Spain. Carlos is twenty-two years old and Rosa is twenty years old.
questions.answerUz: Ular Ispaniyadan. Carlos yigirma ikki yoshda, Rosa esa yigirma yoshda.

questions.en: Where is Veena from? What's her favourite sport?
questions.answerEn: She's from New Delhi, India. Her favourite sport is volleyball.
questions.answerUz: U Yangi Dehlidan, Hindistondan. Sevimli sporti — voleybol.
